index_dict_ints.note: to_entropy and check look words up in a word-to-index dict built once per instance (first index kept, as list.index does) instead of a linear list.index scan, and pack the 11-bit indexes into one integer instead of a list of bools or a binary string; the checksum is the top bits of the first SHA-256 byte. Error types, messages and their order are unchanged.

mnemonic_ints.note: to_mnemonic appends the checksum bits (the top len*8/32 bits of the first SHA-256 byte) to the entropy as an integer and slices 11-bit word indexes with shifts, instead of formatting and zero-filling binary strings and parsing each 11-character slice.
